reuse.why: linkFintegraAccount copies an existing provider link body and downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions, and the unlink field-clearing copies unlinkAccount instead of sharing any of them.

duplication.why: Three sizeable blocks are duplicated: the full link flow for Fintegra, the token-authed transaction download, and the unlink column reset.

placement.why: Link preconditions live in accounts/app.ts as a helper called by every provider, but a function named assert* also mutates other accounts (unlinks them) and checks the closed rule.

scope.why: Changes cover the four requested behaviours plus release notes; no unrelated code edits.

maintainability.why: Every provider now has its own copy of the link flow, the precondition helper hides side effects behind an assert name, and any change to unlinking or downloading must be made in two places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked re-implements unlinkAccount's column reset instead of extracting it; downloadFintegraTransactions duplicates downloadAkahuTransactions rather than parametrising it.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated blocks are near-verbatim copies (renamed provider strings and server URL), not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked accumulates the replaceExistingLink flag, a closed-target branch and a replace branch that unlinks other accounts, turning an assertion into a mutating precondition routine; all six link functions call it.
